name: Skull Pop: The Carnival of the Dead
source:
Kanzaki Rika, obsessed with ghosts, awakens five talking skulls from a mysterious book. Alongside Saki and Rui, she forms SKULL POP to confront the supernatural threatening their town.

[From [url=https://pokapokaworks.itch.io/skullpop-the-carnival-of-the-dead-sound-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对鬼魂着迷的神崎梨香从一本神秘的书中唤醒了五个会说话的头骨。她与Saki和Rui一起组建了SKULL POP，以对抗威胁小镇的超自然力量。

[来自[url=https://pokapokaworks.itch.io/skullpop-the-carnival-of-the-dead-sound-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
